label: Rigid initial profile, bearer omission and transfer triad checked
meaning: Incompatible triad: under the rigid M profile any E-admitted history without the actual initial bearer is M-inadmissible. Restricted inclusion over all such histories is only a sufficient strengthening; an E-based case for an alternative start needs just one M-accessible bearer-omitting E-admitted history (the edge of the edge-check result), which the rigid profile also denies. Conditional on internal hypotheses; neither refutes fixed-history necessity nor establishes it.
